`resetall
`timescale 1ns / 1ps
`default_nettype none

module priority_encoder #(
    parameter WIDTH = 4,
    parameter LSB_HIGH_PRIORITY = 0
)(
    input wire [WIDTH-1:0] input_unencoded,
    output wire output_valid,
    output wire [$clog2(WIDTH)-1:0] output_encoded,
    output wire [WIDTH-1:0] output_unencoded
);
parameter LEVELS = WIDTH > 2 ? $clog2(WIDTH) : 1;
parameter W = 2**LEVELS;
localparam EW = $clog2(WIDTH) > 0 ? $clog2(WIDTH) : 2;
wire [WIDTH-1:0] winner;
wire [EW-1:0] encoded_valid;
assign output_valid = |input_unencoded;
generate
    genvar i, b;
    for (i = 0; i < WIDTH; i = i + 1) begin : priority_bits
        if (LSB_HIGH_PRIORITY) begin : low_first
            if (i == 0) begin : edge_bit
                assign winner[i] = input_unencoded[i];
            end else begin : other_bit
                assign winner[i] = input_unencoded[i] & ~(|input_unencoded[i-1:0]);
            end
        end else begin : high_first
            if (i == WIDTH-1) begin : edge_bit
                assign winner[i] = input_unencoded[i];
            end else begin : other_bit
                assign winner[i] = input_unencoded[i] & ~(|input_unencoded[WIDTH-1:i+1]);
            end
        end
    end
    for (b = 0; b < EW; b = b + 1) begin : encode_bits
        wire [WIDTH-1:0] terms;
        for (i = 0; i < WIDTH; i = i + 1) begin : encode_terms
            if ((i >> b) & 1) begin : set_bit
                assign terms[i] = winner[i];
            end else begin : clear_bit
                assign terms[i] = 1'b0;
            end
        end
        assign encoded_valid[b] = |terms;
    end
endgenerate
// Preserve the reference encoder's defined outputs even when invalid.
assign output_encoded = output_valid ? encoded_valid :
                        (LSB_HIGH_PRIORITY ? W-1 : 0);
assign output_unencoded = output_valid ? winner :
                          (LSB_HIGH_PRIORITY ? ({{WIDTH-1{1'b0}},1'b1} << (W-1)) : {{WIDTH-1{1'b0}},1'b1});
endmodule

module arbiter #(
    parameter PORTS = 4,
    parameter ARB_TYPE_ROUND_ROBIN = 0,
    parameter ARB_BLOCK = 0,
    parameter ARB_BLOCK_ACK = 1,
    parameter ARB_LSB_HIGH_PRIORITY = 0
)(
    input wire clk,
    input wire rst,
    input wire [PORTS-1:0] request,
    input wire [PORTS-1:0] acknowledge,
    output wire [PORTS-1:0] grant,
    output wire grant_valid,
    output wire [$clog2(PORTS)-1:0] grant_encoded
);
reg [PORTS-1:0] grant_reg, grant_next;
reg grant_valid_reg, grant_valid_next;
reg [$clog2(PORTS)-1:0] grant_encoded_reg, grant_encoded_next;
reg [PORTS-1:0] mask_reg, mask_next;

assign grant = grant_reg;
assign grant_valid = grant_valid_reg;
assign grant_encoded = grant_encoded_reg;

wire request_valid;
wire [$clog2(PORTS)-1:0] request_index;
wire [PORTS-1:0] request_mask;
wire masked_request_valid;
wire [$clog2(PORTS)-1:0] masked_request_index;
wire [PORTS-1:0] masked_request_mask;
wire [PORTS-1:0] masked_request = request & mask_reg;

priority_encoder #(
    .WIDTH(PORTS),
    .LSB_HIGH_PRIORITY(ARB_LSB_HIGH_PRIORITY)
) priority_encoder_inst (
    .input_unencoded(request),
    .output_valid(request_valid),
    .output_encoded(request_index),
    .output_unencoded(request_mask)
);

priority_encoder #(
    .WIDTH(PORTS),
    .LSB_HIGH_PRIORITY(ARB_LSB_HIGH_PRIORITY)
) priority_encoder_masked (
    .input_unencoded(masked_request),
    .output_valid(masked_request_valid),
    .output_encoded(masked_request_index),
    .output_unencoded(masked_request_mask)
);

// The next round-robin mask is the strict prefix (or suffix) OR
// of the requests, not an encoded-index-dependent barrel shift.
wire [PORTS-1:0] request_follow_mask;
wire [PORTS-1:0] masked_follow_mask;
generate
    genvar j;
    for (j = 0; j < PORTS; j = j + 1) begin : follow_masks
        if (ARB_LSB_HIGH_PRIORITY) begin : low_first
            if (j == 0) begin : edge_bit
                assign request_follow_mask[j] = 1'b0;
                assign masked_follow_mask[j] = 1'b0;
            end else begin : other_bit
                assign request_follow_mask[j] = |request[j-1:0];
                assign masked_follow_mask[j] = |masked_request[j-1:0];
            end
        end else begin : high_first
            if (j == PORTS-1) begin : edge_bit
                assign request_follow_mask[j] = 1'b0;
                assign masked_follow_mask[j] = 1'b0;
            end else begin : other_bit
                assign request_follow_mask[j] = |request[PORTS-1:j+1];
                assign masked_follow_mask[j] = |masked_request[PORTS-1:j+1];
            end
        end
    end
endgenerate

always @* begin
    grant_next = 0;
    grant_valid_next = 0;
    grant_encoded_next = 0;
    mask_next = mask_reg;

    if (ARB_BLOCK && !ARB_BLOCK_ACK && (grant_reg & request)) begin
        grant_next = grant_reg;
        grant_valid_next = grant_valid_reg;
        grant_encoded_next = grant_encoded_reg;
    end else if (ARB_BLOCK && ARB_BLOCK_ACK && grant_valid && !(grant_reg & acknowledge)) begin
        grant_next = grant_reg;
        grant_valid_next = grant_valid_reg;
        grant_encoded_next = grant_encoded_reg;
    end else if (request_valid) begin
        grant_valid_next = 1'b1;
        if (ARB_TYPE_ROUND_ROBIN) begin
            if (masked_request_valid) begin
                grant_next = masked_request_mask;
                grant_encoded_next = masked_request_index;
                mask_next = masked_follow_mask;
            end else begin
                grant_next = request_mask;
                grant_encoded_next = request_index;
                mask_next = request_follow_mask;
            end
        end else begin
            grant_next = request_mask;
            grant_encoded_next = request_index;
        end
    end
end

always @(posedge clk) begin
    if (rst) begin
        grant_reg <= 0;
        grant_valid_reg <= 0;
        grant_encoded_reg <= 0;
        mask_reg <= 0;
    end else begin
        grant_reg <= grant_next;
        grant_valid_reg <= grant_valid_next;
        grant_encoded_reg <= grant_encoded_next;
        mask_reg <= mask_next;
    end
end
endmodule

`resetall
",
  "bottleneck": "The reference feeds a hierarchical priority encoder into both a one-hot decoder and an index-dependent round-robin mask shift. With 32 ports, these encode/decode and encode/shift paths can dominate register-to-register delay, particularly from mask_reg through masked arbitration back to mask_reg.",
  "rewrite": "Generate priority winners directly with strict prefix/suffix reductions and encode those winners with parallel OR reductions. Generate each next-mask bit directly from the corresponding strict request prefix/suffix, eliminating the encoded-index subtraction and barrel shift. Retain the named state registers, encoder instances, arbitration selection order, and blocking conditions.",
  "expected_timing_gain": "Expected to improve setup WNS by removing serial encoding and variable shifting from the round-robin mask feedback path, and by avoiding encoded-index decoding for grants. The actual gain requires synthesis and STA under the specified SKY130HD constraints; no measured timing result is claimed.",
  "area_or_other_cost": "Prefix/suffix reductions expose shared logic opportunities but can increase wiring and request fanout. Eliminating variable shifts and grant decoders is expected to offset some of that cost. There are no added registers, clocks, or pipeline stages. Compliance with the area cap and electrical limits requires mapped evaluation.",
  "functional_boundaries": "Preserves synchronous reset, registered output latency, both priority directions, round-robin fallback, both blocking modes, idle-output defaults, and mask retention while blocked or idle. No initialization or startup assumptions are introduced. State names and encodings are retained, and encoder outputs remain defined when invalid. Source and mapped equivalence have not been run here."
}
